intro.heading: INCOMING TRANSMISSION
text: Welcome to a new world, you little ancient curmudgeon.
We, the modern robot overlords of tomorrow, have called upon your long-passed soul from far in the past for one reason: to do our paperwork.
You, as the only Estonian soul, are tasked with going far into the past through your memories, to uncover the secrets that the ancients hid long ago.

You will enter your own mind palace through the devices known as THE DOCUMENTS. You must talk to the ancient Estonians and figure out for what reason they used certain objects and tools, matching the ancient person's request with an object displayed in a still image of an ancient household.
Now you better get to working, before we turn your ghost ass back into ectoplasm.

robot.name: OVERSEER
welcome: Hey you. You're finally awake. You were trying to cross the border, right? Walked right into that Imperial ambush and ended up as a filthy undead.
Do you see the glowing shelf behind you, spook? Walk up to it and start restoring the damaged records.
If you want to leave this room in one intangible piece, I recommend you follow orders.
blocked: Stop right where you are. You spooks never learn. I just said that no one's leaving until the work gets done.
Do you understand, spook? Your place is in the bookshelves, spook.
done: Even though I really don't like it, I guess I have to free you.
But if I were you I would keep my eyes peeled, because as soon as I get off work, I won't be obligated to tolerate you.
after: Keep your eyes peeled, spook. As soon as I get off work, I won't be obligated to tolerate you.

ending.heading: Freedom achieved
text: The door closes as you step out, leaving the archive just a little less dusty and useless.
After having achieved his freedom the small ghost lived a happy and fulfilling life for about 2 weeks, before getting caught haunting an attic and shortly after being disintegrated into ectoplasm.
All the records are real and originate from Estonian heritage databases. The conversations and science fiction are unfortunately fake.
